UPPER FACE. [8] [Bapt.]
Looked ill for two weeks. θ Typhus.
Anxious, frightened look. θ Cough.
Yellowish cheeks ; central deep flush. θ Typhus.
Face : sallow ; dark red, with besotted expression ; flushed, dusky ; hot and perceptibly flushed.
Burning, prickling of left side of face and head.
Burning heat in face with flushed cheeks. θ Diphtheria.
Cheeks burn.
Cheeks flushed, dark violet. θ Cough.
Heat all over, most in face. θ Typhus.
Critical sweat on forehead and face. θ Typhus.
Face and whole head feel numb.
Muscles of jaw rigid.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Bapt.]
Pain in articulation of lower jaw. θ Typhus.
Jaw dropped. θ Typhus.
Cracked lips, with bleeding and ulceration of bowels. θ Typhus.
Pain in region of right mastoid process.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Bapt.]
Teeth and gums sore ; by pressing with finger large quantities of blood ooze out.
Sordes on teeth and lips ; tongue ulcerated. θ Typhus.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Bapt.]
Taste : flat, bitter, sometimes putrid.
Filthy taste with flow of saliva.
Foul or bitter nauseous taste in mouth. θ Typhus.
Tongue swollen, thick, making talking difficult.
Slight heat or burning at root of tongue.
Tongue red and dry in middle. θ Typhus.
Tongue feels dry on rubbing against roof of mouth ; smarts, feels burned.
The roof of tongue is swollen and feels numb. θ Diphtheria.
Tongue of a dark hue. θ Cough.
Dry, parched, thickly coated tongue. θ Typhus.
Tongue dry, brown down centre. θ Typhus.
Tongue covered with a thick, brown crust. θ Typhus.
Tongue baked down centre. θ Typhus.
Tongue at first white with red papillæ here and there, followed by a yellow-brown coating in centre, edges being red, shining.
Tongue coated white, yellow or yellowish-brown, and feels as if burned or scalded. θ Diphtheria.
Tongue yellowish-white, deeply furred. θ Typhus.
Tongue has a yellow centre, or yellowish-brown coating, dry. θ Typhus.
Foul tongue. θ Typhus.
Tongue feels as though it had been scraped, and sensation extending to fauces.
Tongue cracked down centre.
Cracked, sore, ulcerated tongue. θ Typhus.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Bapt.]
Stomatitis materna ; breath fetid ; feeble state.
Fetid odor ; also after mercury.
Mouth and tongue very dry. θ In fevers.
Filthy taste, with flow of saliva.
Saliva rather abundant, somewhat viscid, tasting flat.
Copious saliva : followed by sore throat, scraping, burning ; slight pain in right lung.
Copious flow of saliva ; ulcers in mouth.
Cancrum oris, copious saliva ; gums loose, flabby, dark red, or purple ; fetid.
Aphthæ. θ Typhus.
Sore mouth of sucklings and consumptives.
Canker sores in mouth.
Ulcerations extending from mouth, through alimentary canal, with watery discharges from bowels.
Putrid ulceration of buccal cavity, with salivation ; well-developed ulcers, slight pain.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Bapt.]
Pain and soreness of fauces. θ Diphtheria.
Hot feeling in fauces, passing up into ears ; sensation as if had eaten pepper.
Fauces dark red ; dark, putrid ulcers ; tonsils and parotids swollen ; unusual absence of pain. θ Diphtheria. θ Putrid sore throat, etc. θ Typhus. θ Variola.
Scraping and burning, raw sensation in pharynx ; much viscid mucus ; copious flow of saliva ; ulcers in mouth.
Dry scraping in throat when swallowing ; tongue coated white, especially at root ; fetid perspiration of body, and especially hands ; eyes much injected ; face and ears hot and very red ; absence of thirst ; heaviness in chest, with dull pain in region of spleen.
Burning and heat in fauces, as from heartburn, extending into ears ; < from belching, which causes pain to extend into chest, and there producing a weak feeling.
Tonsils and soft palate swollen, with constant inclination to swallow, not accompanied by pain. θ Diphtheria.
Stitches in right tonsil.
Tonsils and soft palate very red, but not painful.
Pricking in upper part of pharynx ; raw sensation.
Tickling in throat provoking cough ; uvula elongated.
Sore throat.
Throat sore ; averse to open air.
Mucus abundant and viscid, can neither be swallowed nor expectorated.
Mucus rattles in throat. θ Typhus.
Œsophagus feels as if constricted from above down to stomach ; can only swallow water.
Constrictive feeling causing frequent efforts at deglutition ; throat sore, feels contracted.
Throat feels swollen, full ; tonsils and soft palate congested ; frequent inclination to swallow, causing pain in root of tongue.
Spits out liquids put in mouth. θ Typhus.
Can swallow liquids only ; least solid food gags. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus. θ Diarrhœa.
Children cannot swallow solid food ; the smallest solid substance causes gagging, thus they cannot use anything but milk ; sometimes thin, watery, offensive passages day and night. (Compare Silicea).
Unable to swallow. θ Typhus.
Paralysis of organs of deglutition. θ Typhus.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Bapt.]
Loss of appetite. θ Typhus.
Constant desire for water, with nausea and want of appetite. θ Typhus.
Spitting out of liquids put into her mouth.
Great thirst. θ Typhus.
A good deal of thirst. θ Typhus.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Bapt.]
All symptoms < from beer.
After breakfast, dull feeling.
Hiccough, Belching, Nausea and Vomiting
